fields.label: Enable Synapse Endpoint
fields.description: Master switch. Off means every tool refuses, whatever else is configured here.

fields.options: Tools are exposed at /api/method/synapse.mcp.handle_mcp. What a caller can reach is decided by the Synapse Profile records whose roles they hold, unioned together. Frappe permissions always apply on top, they are never bypassed. Raw SQL is the exception, and it ignores permissions entirely.

fields.label: Model Provider
fields.description: The model family this endpoint is presented for. Only Claude is wired up today; the rest are placeholders.

fields.options: This setting does not change how tools run. It records which model family the site is presenting Synapse for. Support beyond Claude is not implemented yet.

fields.label: Enable Read Tools
fields.description: get_doc, get_value, get_list, get_count, describe_doctype, list_available_doctypes

fields.label: Enable Write Tools
fields.description: create_doc, update_doc, set_value, submit_doc, cancel_doc, delete_doc, the child-table tools, replace_in_field and run_operation

fields.label: Enable Read-Only SQL Tool
fields.description: Also needs a Synapse Profile with 'Allow SQL' ticked. Raw SQL ignores all DocType permissions.

fields.label: Enable Custom Tools
fields.description: Turn on tools contributed by other installed apps. Each still has to be named in a Synapse Profile. Off means no custom tool runs, whatever a profile lists.

fields.label: Row Limit
fields.description: Rows any single call may return. Capped at 500 by the app.

fields.label: Date Format
fields.description: How dates are returned to the client. Writes always accept either form, so changing this cannot break a round trip.

fields.options: Access is granted by Synapse Profile records, not here. A user's reach is the union of every enabled profile whose roles they hold. With no profile, nothing is reachable. The list below is a site-wide backstop: it blocks actions no agent may take whatever a profile grants.

Token and credential DocTypes are always blocked, and schema, code and permission DocTypes (DocType, Custom Field, Server Script, Custom DocPerm, Role, User ...) are always read only, whether or not they appear below. Add a row only to block something a profile would otherwise allow.

fields.label: Allow System Manager Config Writes
fields.description: Lets a caller who holds the System Manager role create and update the read-only backstop DocTypes (Workflow, Custom Field, Property Setter, Report, Role, User Permission, DocType and the like) through MCP, since they can already do so in the desk. Off by default. Delete and run_operation on these stay blocked. Token, credential and Synapse's own control-plane DocTypes stay blocked for everyone whatever this is set to.

fields.options: On Frappe v15, Synapse serves the OAuth discovery an MCP client needs (/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource), pointing at Frappe's own OAuth endpoints. On Frappe v16 this section is ignored: turn on the matching switches in OAuth Settings instead.

fields.label: Allow Dynamic Client Registration
fields.description: Lets an MCP client such as Claude register itself as an OAuth Client, so nobody has to create one by hand. Registering grants nothing by itself: a user still signs in and approves the client, and gets only their own permissions. Rate limited per IP. Frappe v15 only.

fields.label: Log Field Values
fields.description: Store submitted values and before/after changes on each Synapse Log row. Password-like fields are always masked. Untick if the data itself must not be duplicated into the log.

fields.label: Retention (Days)
fields.description: A daily job drops Synapse Log rows older than this.
